objective: One situated Observer2 identity observes multiple substrate-specific environments without assuming one filesystem/root substrate; observed state remains evidence-only and actuation stays outside the observer.

resident_mechanics_reused: BRAINK recursive-computer identity/lineage state export boundary
R12/R13/R17 BRAINK machine-image and public-edge contracts

invariants: repository is one observed environment, not the universal state owner
probe failure is UNAVAILABLE evidence and is not converted to absence
observer probes cannot expose write/mutate/delete/commit/actuate surfaces
SelfAddressingRuntime route/checkpoint are never invoked by the observer adapter
RecursiveComputer commit is never invoked by the observer adapter
KEX coordinate dispatch is never invoked by the observer adapter
pre/post relation compares environment status and payload roots rather than sampling-time noise
observer identity must remain stable across pre/post comparison
continuation is FOLLOW_SUCCESSOR_STATE only when the declared target is satisfied; otherwise RECONCILE
